unitTitle: Adjectives/Order of Adjectives/Comparisons - Expressing Certainty - Will

pairsWith.noteUz: 1-3-unitlar takrori (Revision): xatolarni tuzatish va 22 ta test savoli.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 3-UNIT: REVISION UNITS 1-3 (19-bet, PDF 18). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '3'. Jigarrang yo'lak 'Revision: Units 1 - 3'.

CHAP USTUN:
14) 'Correct the mistakes, as in the example.' 1 Tricia haven't got blue eyes. → hasn't 2 "I love going to the theatre." "So am I." 3 At the moment, Jim rides his bicycle. 4 John gave she the gift. 5 Julie is waking up at 7.00 every morning. 6 Mike goes to a party on Saturday night. 7 Donna use to have long hair. 8 Mr Smith work at the General Hospital. 9 Is the Sears Tower one of the taller buildings in the world? 10 Sam often eating Chinese food. 11 Her bicycle is most comfortable than Tom's. 12 Did you watched the football game last night? 13 I often goes fishing on Sundays. 14 Paul didn't used to work at a restaurant. 15 He leaves Tokyo next Monday.
15) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 What time ...... you leave for school? A does B are C do. 2 The library ...... got many interesting books. A have B has C does. 3 We ...... to the circus last Sunday. A went B go C gone. 4 A: Do you eat cereal for breakfast? B: No, I ...... eat cereal for breakfast. A sometimes B often C never. 5 Did Sue ...... to wear contact lenses? A used B use C uses. 6 "He always drinks a cup of hot chocolate before going to bed." "So ...... Susan." A did B does C do.

O'NG USTUN:
7 Excuse me. I'm ...... for Maine Street. A look B looked C looking. 8 What colour hair ...... she got? A is B has C does. 9 This dress is ...... than the other. A worse B bad C worst. 10 They will probably ...... at noon. A arrived B arriving C arrive. 11 It ...... be cold outside. They're wearing their jackets. A can't B can C must. 12 I think the Taj Mahal is one of the ...... impressive monuments in the world. A more B most C much. 13 Archie's has the ...... apple pie in town. A best B better C good. 14 Where does Jenny ...... from? A comes B come C coming. 15 Ken ...... got very broad shoulders. A has B does C is. 16 ...... the Rialto use to be a cinema? A Do B Does C Did. 17 Ray ...... in the gym every day. A exercise B exercises C exercising. 18 Helen is ...... her room at the moment. A tidying B tidies C tidied. 19 Heather ...... going scuba diving in her free time. A loving B love C loves. 20 Jeff ...... use to have a car when he was 18 years old. A didn't B did C does. 21 Next year we ...... travelling to the south of France. A do B are C is. 22 Tom's cat died. He ...... be very sad. A can B can't C must.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '19'.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example. Example: Tricia haven't got blue eyes. → hasn't
exercises.instructionUz: Xatolarni tuzating, namunadagidek. Namuna: Tricia haven't got blue eyes. → hasn't
exercises.explanationUz:
1-3-UNITLAR XATOLARI.

  1 haven't → HASN'T (3-shaxs)
  2 So am I → So DO I ('love' →
    do)
  3 rides → IS RIDING (At the
    moment)
  4 she → HER (tushum)
  5 is waking up → WAKES UP (every
    morning)
  6 goes → IS GOING (Saturday night
    - reja) - yoki 'on Saturday
    nights' odat
  7 use → USED (tasdiq)
  8 work → WORKS (3-shaxs)
  9 taller → TALLEST (one of the
    + orttirma)
  10 eating → EATS (often - odat)
  11 most → MORE (than)
  12 watched → WATCH (Did + asosiy)
  13 goes → GO (I)
  14 used → USE (didn't + use)
  15 leaves → IS LEAVING (next
     Monday - reja)


⚠ 'THE SEARS TOWER':

  = Chikagodagi osmono'par bino.

items.textEn: What time ___ you leave for school?
The library ___ got many interesting books.
We ___ to the circus last Sunday.
A: Do you eat cereal for breakfast? B: No, I ___ eat cereal for breakfast.
items.uz: Nonushtaga don mahsulotlari yeysanmi? - Yo'q, hech qachon yemayman.

items.textEn: Did Sue ___ to wear contact lenses?
"He always drinks a cup of hot chocolate before going to bed." "So ___ Susan."
items.uz: "U uxlashdan oldin doim issiq shokolad ichadi." "Syuzan ham."

items.textEn: Excuse me. I'm ___ for Maine Street.
What colour hair ___ she got?
This dress is ___ than the other.
They will probably ___ at noon.
It ___ be cold outside. They're wearing their jackets.
items.uz: Tashqarida sovuq bo'lsa kerak. Ular kurtka kiyishgan.

items.textEn: I think the Taj Mahal is one of the ___ impressive monuments in the world.
items.uz: Menimcha, Toj Mahal dunyodagi eng ta'sirchan yodgorliklardan biri.

items.textEn: Archie's has the ___ apple pie in town.
items.uz: Archie's da shahardagi eng yaxshi olma pirogi bor.

items.textEn: Where does Jenny ___ from?
Ken ___ got very broad shoulders.
___ the Rialto use to be a cinema?
Ray ___ in the gym every day.
items.uz: Rey har kuni sport zalida mashq qiladi.

items.textEn: Helen is ___ her room at the moment.
Heather ___ going scuba diving in her free time.
items.uz: Xezer bo'sh vaqtida akvalang bilan sho'ng'ishni yaxshi ko'radi.

items.textEn: Jeff ___ use to have a car when he was 18 years old.
Next year we ___ travelling to the south of France.
items.uz: Keyingi yil biz Fransiya janubiga sayohat qilamiz.

items.textEn: Tom's cat died. He ___ be very sad.
items.uz: Tomning mushugi o'ldi. U juda xafa bo'lsa kerak.

patterns.formula: one of the + ORTTIRMA + OT(lar) + in the world
patterns.exampleEn: The Taj Mahal is one of the most impressive monuments in the world.
patterns.exampleUz: Toj Mahal dunyodagi eng ta'sirchan yodgorliklardan biri.
